criteria.criterion: vloop defect set <id> rule '<where>: <which>' accepts <where> in guideline, brief-check, gate, gate-review, review, skill; vloop defect set <id> rule-outcome accepts fired, missed, absent, none; anything else exits 2 and leaves the record byte-identical
criteria.evidence: internal/defect/defect.go Validate; TestSetRuleAndOutcome asserts InvalidValueError and byte-identical file

criteria.criterion: defect/v1 gains `rule` and `rule-outcome` as optional properties: no schema version changes and records without them stay valid; vloop defect set's help lists the two fields and docs/guide/commands.md is regenerated
criteria.evidence: schemas/defect.v1.json adds both, not required; SetFields and commands.md updated

criteria.criterion: vloop brief close prints, after recording the findings and before its `squash-merge with the trailer` line (which stays last), `defects of <run id>` then one line per defect recorded for the brief: `  <id>  <kind>  <found-by>  <rule or —>  <rule-outcome or untriaged>[  recurs ×<n> (<id>, <id>)]`; then, when any is untriaged, `<n> untriaged: vloop defect set <id> rule '<where>: <which>' and rule-outcome fired|missed|absent|none`, <n> the number of untriaged defects and the rest literal; with no defects, `defects of <run id>: none`
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/close.go printDefectReport and its call before the trailer; TestCloseDefectReport, TestCloseDefectReportNone

criteria.criterion: recurs lists the other defects, of any brief, with the same rule, by short ID (D<stamp>), oldest first, at most three, with the total count; an untriaged defect never recurs
criteria.evidence: close.go printDefectReport appends recurs whenever d.Rule != "", although a defect with a rule and no rule-outcome is printed as untriaged; no test covers it

criteria.criterion: --dry-run prints the report as it would be and writes nothing; --json is unchanged; close never refuses for an untriaged defect. Violation: a close that refuses, or a report that writes anything, for an untriaged defect
criteria.evidence: closeDryRun prints the report; TestCloseDefectReport checks clean status and unchanged HEAD

criteria.criterion: plugin/skills/operate/SKILL.md's close step gains the triage: for each untriaged defect propose its rule and rule-outcome as options and record the operator's choice; for absent, draft the guideline line with its provenance, or the check; for a gate-review rule that missed, propose an eval case and the defect's case:. The skill stays within its 1,750-word ceiling and changes nowhere else
criteria.evidence: SKILL.md step 3 added; 1686 words; the diff touches only the close step

criteria.criterion: TestCloseCommitsFindingsSnapshotAndBrief (internal/cli/close_test.go) and B4's worked-example test (cmd/vloop/b4_e2e_test.go) change only by the report's lines before the trailer; committed tests cover the two fields, both refusals, the report with rule, untriaged and recurs, no defects and --dry-run. Violation: the behaviour shipped with no committed test the checks run
criteria.evidence: close_test.go changes only the tail line expectations; new tests cover all listed cases; b4_e2e_test.go untouched and the go check passes

criteria.criterion: No earlier test is weakened: only the tests the brief's Constraints list change, and only as they state
criteria.evidence: the only edit to an existing test is the tail assertion in TestCloseCommitsFindingsSnapshotAndBrief

findings.summary: a defect with a rule but no rule-outcome is shown as untriaged yet still gets a recurs suffix, and counts toward others' recurs; the criterion says an untriaged defect never recurs

notes: The fix is small: gate the recurs suffix (and arguably the matching set) on a non-empty RuleOutcome, and add a test with a rule and no outcome. The brief could say whether untriaged means no outcome or no rule.
